article_title: 从 17ms 到 0.04ms：如何设计正确的 SQL 索引
core_theme: 设计数据库索引时，列的顺序决定了索引能否被查询用上；用 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 实测，把全表扫描的慢查询改成秒回的复合索引
reader_takeaway: 明白复合索引的列顺序规则——等值列在前、排序列在后——以及为什么索引要按真实查询来设计
summary_angle: 用一张对比封面呈现「全表扫描 17ms」和「正确复合索引 0.04ms」的强烈反差

information_blocks.source_anchor: 慢查询：全表扫描 1 百万行，Execution Time 17.066ms
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左侧是一叠陈旧的卡片/堆栈，上面贴着笨拙的扫描箭头，标注 17ms

information_blocks.source_anchor: 复合索引 (issue_id, user_id, created_at DESC)：三个条件全进 Index Cond，Sort 消失，0.04ms
information_blocks.visual_idea: 右侧是一棵整齐的 B-tree 结构，箭头直指对应的一小格，标注 0.04ms

information_blocks.source_anchor: 列顺序规则：等值列在前，然后才是排序列
information_blocks.visual_idea: 索引树的一角用醒目的标签标出「等值列 → 排序列」

main_metaphor: 把一棵排序整齐的索引树与乱序堆叠的扫描卡堆并置，表现「正确列顺序」与「全表扫描」的对比
primary_subject: 一棵整齐的 B-tree 索引树
subject_action: 树的正中有一格被箭头精准定位并读出

final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 设计正确的 SQL 复合索引，列顺序决定查询能否被索引用上。The reader should quickly feel 从慢查询到秒回的差别。Summary angle: 用一张对比封面呈现「全表扫描 17ms」和「正确复合索引 0.04ms」的强烈反差。Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject (a tidy B-tree index tree) and 2-3 supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: (1) contrast 左侧叠放陈旧的卡片堆与笨拙扫描箭头 label 全表扫描 numeric 17ms; (2) mechanism 右侧整齐 B-tree 树、箭头精准指到一小格 label 复合索引 numeric 0.04ms; (3) takeaway 索引树一角标出「等值列→排序列」 label 列顺序 numeric 1/2/3. Main metaphor: 把排序整齐的索引树与乱序堆叠的扫描卡堆并置，表现正确列顺序与全表扫描的对比。Subject: 一棵整齐的 B-tree 索引树，正中一格被箭头精准定位并读出。Composition/framing: 左右对照，图表式的水平叙述，在宽封面里保持可读。Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: warm hand-drawn animation feeling, natural environments, gentle fantasy everyday mood, soft painterly backgrounds, no studio imitation. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: 暖木色、苔绿色、奶油白、墨蓝点缀。Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary: 17ms, 0.04ms, 列顺序, 全表扫描, 复合索引. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 真实数据库截图、仪表盘、图表坐标轴、英文章节长句、装饰性芯片堆砌、代码雨、霓虹光污染。
